cohort: The study included all nulliparous women who delivered vaginally at term between 2011 and 2019 at a tertiary university hospital.
finding: Lateral and mediolateral episiotomies are independent modifiable predictors of OASI, protective against OASI in spontaneous vaginal deliveries when neonates weigh > 3000 g and in vacuum-assisted deliveries when neonates weigh 2500-3499 g.
mod_finding: Episiotomies were found to be protective against OASI, with the effect varying by mode of vaginal birth (spontaneous vs. vacuum-assisted delivery) and neonatal birthweight.
birth_weight: Neonates were analyzed across various birthweight groups (e.g., 2500-2999g, 3000-3499g, 3500-3999g, >4000g).
gest_age: Women who delivered vaginally at term were included.
